rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=0.5, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=20, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-8 LAST-ORTHOGONAL probe (fd_recon_eta 1.0->0.5), fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained breast val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: RMSE-headroom SATURATED at PSNR~28.9/RMSE~0.0122 -- iter-5(n_cg20,NFE8)=28.91, iter-7(NFE16)=28.90 (NFE doubling gave 0 dB). All ~7.4 dB below the 128-view sparse-FBP floor (36.32/0.0052), hr=0. (2) Failure mode: 4 axes exhausted (dc_relax, init_t, n_cg, NFE); recon pinned below FBP by the mis-scaled Mayo prior + discrete-CG-DC ceiling. eta (DPS guidance scale) is the ONLY sampler axis never moved. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_eta 1.0->0.5 (less DPS-guidance injection = more deterministic trajectory), from best config (n_cg20,init_t0.4,NFE8,relax1.0). (4) HYPOTHESIS: lower eta reduces stochastic prior-guidance noise so PSNR nudges up; mirrors the mayo sibling where eta moved PSNR ~0 (noise). If flat, ALL 5 sampler/DC axes are exhausted and the WDM-Mayo-prior recon is confirmed below-baseline on sparse breast (regime/domain-bound hr=0); iters 9-20 = confirmation replays of the best config (iter-5 tier). (5) BUDGET: free knob, iter-5 was 144s. (6) Loop continues; iter-9 on landing.
